clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; covers the separate responsibility to determine safety settings and factuality tools for the licensee's use case. Applications with less restrictive safety settings may be subject to Google's review and approval; no approval requirement is stated categorically.
clauses.condition_explanation: determine_necessary_and_appropriate_safety_settings_and_factuality_tools means the licensee determines the safety settings and factuality tools necessary and appropriate for its use case. This clause supplements the prohibition already represented by safety_measures_and_settings.

obligation_items.content: Determine the safety settings and factuality tools necessary and appropriate for the use case.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes Google's use of submitted content and generated responses for the stated service, improvement, and development purposes, and human review for quality and improvement.
clauses.condition_explanation: unpaid_service_use includes Google AI Studio and unpaid Gemini API quota. The stated purposes include providing, improving, and developing Google products, services, and machine-learning technologies, including enterprise features. Human reviewers may read, annotate, and process API input and output to help with quality and product improvement. Google states that it takes privacy-protective steps, including disconnecting the data from the Google Account, API key, and Cloud project before reviewers see or annotate it. The Privacy Policy is referenced but not supplied; its contents are not inferred.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; states that the license granted to Google under the API Terms' Submission of Content section extends, to the extent required under applicable law for Google's use, to submitted content and generated responses. The underlying API Terms grant is not supplied, so this clause does not infer a grant's scope, conditions, or permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: content_submitted_to_services_or_generated_responses includes prompts, associated system instructions, cached content, and files such as images, videos, or documents, as well as generated responses. The referenced API Terms are not supplied; their incorporated license text is excluded and its terms cannot be determined here.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; states Google's purpose limitation and retention/deletion behavior for content imported or uploaded to the model tuning feature.
clauses.condition_explanation: content_imported_or_uploaded_to_model_tuning_feature is tuning content. use_only_for_express_tuning_purpose means Google uses that content only for the express tuning purpose. The text also states that tuning content may be retained in connection with tuned models for re-tuning when supported models change, and that related tuning content is deleted when the tuned model is deleted.

obligation_items.content: Do not use content imported or uploaded to the model tuning feature for purposes other than the express tuning purpose.
obligation_items.object: content imported or uploaded to the model tuning feature
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Google uses such tuning content.

obligation_items.content: Delete the tuning content related to a tuned model when that tuned model is deleted.
obligation_items.object: tuning content related to the deleted tuned model
obligation_items.trigger: When the tuned model is deleted.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; states provider-side processing and logging conditions for Paid Services. The Data Processing Addendum is externally referenced and not supplied; its contents are not inferred.
clauses.condition_explanation: paid_service_use includes the Paid Services classified by the terms at lines 113–120. Google does not use prompts or responses to improve its products and processes them in accordance with the referenced Data Processing Addendum. Google logs prompts and responses for a limited period solely to detect and prevent Prohibited Use Policy violations, maintain Service safety and security, and make required legal or regulatory disclosures. Data may be stored transiently or cached in countries where Google or its agents maintain facilities. The referenced Addendum is not supplied and is not treated as a missing locally stated rule.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Paid Services prompts or responses to improve products.
obligation_items.trigger: When processing prompts or responses in connection with Paid Services.

obligation_items.content: Do not log prompts or responses for purposes other than detecting and preventing Prohibited Use Policy violations, maintaining Service safety and security, or making required legal or regulatory disclosures.
obligation_items.trigger: When logging prompts or responses; logging is stated to be for a limited period.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; identifies other data collected while providing Paid Services and makes that data subject to the linked Google Controller-Controller Data Protection Terms and Google Privacy Policy. Those documents are externally referenced and not supplied; their substantive requirements are not inferred.
clauses.condition_explanation: Other data expressly identified includes account information and settings, billing history, direct communications and feedback, usage details (including token counts, operational status, safety filter triggers, software errors and crash reports, authentication details, quality and performance metrics, and technical details necessary to operate and maintain Services), and potentially device identifiers, cookie or token identifiers, and IP addresses. The incorporated external documents are not supplied and are excluded from substantive extraction.

coverage_notes: The target paragraphs' local provider-side data handling statements are represented as Google actions where they state actual processing behavior; this does not create licensee permissions or infer the content of linked privacy or data-processing documents.

The referenced API Terms' Submission of Content license and the referenced Paid Services data-processing and controller-controller documents are not supplied. Their substantive terms are not inferred.
